class.name: OcgBrepmeshShapetool
class.brief_description: Auxiliary class providing functionality to compute, retrieve and store data to TopoDS and model shape.
class.description: ! Auxiliary class providing functionality to compute, ! retrieve and store data to TopoDS and model shape.

method.name: MaxFaceTolerance
method.description: Returns maximum tolerance of the given face. Considers tolerances of edges and vertices contained in the given face.

method.name: BoxMaxDimension
method.description: Gets the maximum dimension of the given bounding box. If the given bounding box is void leaves the resulting value unchanged.

method.name: CheckAndUpdateFlags
method.description: Checks same parameter, same range and degenerativity attributes using geometrical data of the given edge and updates edge model by computed parameters in case of worst case - it can drop flags same parameter and same range to False but never to True if it is already set to False. In contrary, it can also drop degenerated flag to True, but never to False if it is already set to True.

method.name: AddInFace
method.description: Stores the given triangulation into the given face.

method.name: NullifyFace
method.description: Nullifies triangulation stored in the face.

method.name: NullifyEdge_2
method.description: Nullifies polygon on triangulation stored in the edge.

method.name: NullifyEdge_1
method.description: Nullifies 3d polygon stored in the edge.

method.name: UpdateEdge_2
method.description: Updates the given edge by the given tessellated representation.

method.name: UpdateEdge_1
method.description: Updates the given edge by the given tessellated representation.

method.name: UpdateEdge_3
method.description: Updates the given seam edge by the given tessellated representations.

method.name: UseLocation
method.description: Applies location to the given point and return result.

method.name: UVPoints
method.description: Gets the strict UV locations of the extremities of the edge using pcurve.

method.name: Range_2
method.description: Gets the parametric range of the given edge on the given face.

method.name: Range_1
method.description: Gets the 3d range of the given edge.
